subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the male exorcist from <Picture 1>: a tall, weathered East Asian man with long windblown black-and-grey hair, a full beard, a stern angular face, layered distressed black robes, red ritual threads, bronze coin charms, faint red sigils glowing around his left hand, and a warm brass spirit lantern secured at his waist. In the target video, he carries a small aged-bronze ritual handbell exclusively in his left hand; the bell remains on the viewer's right side whenever he faces the camera, and his right hand remains free.
<Subject 2> is the evil entity from <Picture 2>: a towering humanoid mass of turbulent black smoke and viscous shadow, with two narrow red eyes, ember-like fissures through its body, slow curling tendrils, and blood-written paper talismans orbiting around it.
<Subject 3> is the abandoned mountain shrine from <Picture 3>: a vertical ruined temple courtyard beneath a clouded moon, with wet black stone steps, crooked tiled roofs, hanging torn cloth, red ritual threads, bronze coins scattered across the ground, pale joss paper, cold blue-grey fog, and isolated warm lantern light.

summary:
[reference generation] The 15-second 9:16 target video follows <Subject 1> as he walks deeper into <Subject 3>. Pale joss paper rises and whirls around him, the camera cuts closer as he rings an aged-bronze ritual handbell in his left hand, and <Subject 2> gradually takes shape inside a wall of black fog. The sequence ends on a tense freeze frame immediately after the exorcist and the entity face one another.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - his facial identity, hair, beard, robes, red threads, coin charms, left-hand sigils, and brass lantern are retained, while the ritual handbell is added as a new story prop held consistently in his left hand.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - its towering black-smoke anatomy, narrow red eyes, ember fissures, curling tendrils, and orbiting blood-written talismans remain visually consistent.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the ruined courtyard layout, wet stone, crooked roofs, clouded moon, hanging cloth, red threads, bronze coins, joss paper, blue-grey fog, and warm practical lantern light remain spatially and atmospherically continuous.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic Chinese dark-fantasy style in a 9:16 vertical frame. Cold blue-grey moonlight defines the ruined shrine, while the lantern at <Subject 1>'s waist supplies a restrained warm rim light. Maintain a coherent forward screen direction and a deliberate escalation from stillness to supernatural confrontation.

[Shot 1] A low rear three-quarter wide shot opens inside <Subject 3>, looking along the wet stone path toward the shadowed temple. <Subject 1> enters from the lower foreground and walks steadily toward the inner courtyard, his gaze fixed on the dark doorway ahead. The camera tracks behind him at walking speed with restrained handheld drift, keeping his full silhouette centered between the crooked roofs. Each step produces a shallow splash and a reflected pulse of lantern light. His robe hem, long hair, red threads, and bronze coin charms respond with natural lag to the cold crosswind. Pale joss paper lies motionless across the stones at first. As he crosses the midpoint of the courtyard, one sheet lifts beside his boot, then dozens rise in sequence and spiral upward around his body without obscuring his face or path. He slows but continues forward, tightening his left-hand grip around the aged-bronze ritual handbell while his right arm remains free beside his body.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut to a medium frontal tracking shot moving backward ahead of <Subject 1>. The papers cross the foreground in layered depth, some passing close to the lens while others circle behind him. His eyes shift briefly toward the moving paper before returning to the temple doorway; the eyes lead, followed by a small turn of the head and a restrained tightening of the jaw. The bell stays in his left hand, appearing on the viewer's right side of the frontal composition. At 00:07.200, cut to an extreme close-up of his left hand. His left fingers secure the bell handle, the red sigils brighten around his wrist and knuckles, and his left wrist draws back before snapping through two controlled arcs. The bell rings twice: the first strike sends a visible circular pressure ripple through the fog; the second makes the joss paper reverse direction in midair. Cut back to his face with the glowing left hand and bell clearly held on the same side, while the warm lantern flame leans sharply toward the temple.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, cut to an over-the-left-shoulder shot behind <Subject 1>, framing the temple doorway and steps beyond him while keeping his raised left forearm and ritual bell visible in the foreground. The second bell resonance continues across the cut. Black fog pours upward from between the wet stones, gathers behind the paper storm, and condenses into <Subject 2>. Its long smoke tendrils form first, followed by its broad torso, ember-like fissures, and finally two narrow red eyes opening in the darkness. The camera makes a slow push toward the entity while preserving <Subject 1>'s left shoulder, glowing left hand, and raised bell in the foreground. <Subject 1> stops completely, lowers his center of gravity, and holds the bell ready at chest height in his left hand; his right hand remains free near his side. His hair and robe settle while the joss paper continues to orbit between them. <Subject 2> leans forward slightly from the black fog but does not attack. At 00:14.400, both figures lock their gaze across the courtyard. The bell's final vibration fades, one sheet of joss paper crosses between their faces, and the image freezes at 00:14.700 on the confrontation: <Subject 1>'s left hand and bell held clearly in the warm-lit foreground, <Subject 2> towering in black fog beneath the moon, red eyes and ember fissures glowing through the suspended paper. Hold the freeze frame through 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Cold mountain wind, distant timber creaks, measured wet footsteps, cloth movement, faint bronze-coin vibration, and dry joss-paper flutter establish the shrine. The ritual handbell rings twice at 00:07.600 and 00:08.500 with a bright metallic attack, long temple-like resonance, and synchronized pressure ripples through the fog. Black fog emerges with a deep airy surge, layered reversed breaths, and a low sub-bass vibration. The final freeze frame leaves only the decaying bell tone and a thin wind hiss.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained 15-second Chinese dark-fantasy score led by low cello, sparse guqin harmonics, distant temple bowl, and a wordless low choir. Begin almost inaudibly, add a tense bowed drone as the joss paper rises, mute the score around each handbell strike, then introduce a low choral swell as <Subject 2> forms. Cut the swell abruptly at the freeze frame and allow one unresolved guqin harmonic to decay into silence.
